== Using the trader ==

# With an empty hand right click the NPC
# To toggle between buying/selling click the lime/cyan wool in the lower right corner.
== Buy menu ==
#Clicking once on an item shows the price or brings up the amount selection menu.
#Clicking the item a second time buys it.<br />
<br />
When in the amount selection menu you can click the red wool to go back to the trader's main inventory.<br />
== Sell menu ==
#Clicking once on an item shows how much you will get for it.
#Clicking the item a second time sells it. 
<br />
'''Note:''' NPCs will not buy anything unless you set up the accepted items and their prices.
